image_description: A collection of colorful, synthetic clown wigs displayed on mannequin heads and stacked in the background. The foreground features a pink wig on a mannequin head with visible facial features, alongside a white wig and a yellow wig. The background contains large, voluminous wigs in blue, green, orange, and yellow. The texture is distinctly synthetic, shiny, and frizzy, typical of costume wigs.
